Real engine output, kept so that every validator can be checked against a file
an engine actually wrote before it is trusted on a new one.

Not hand-written.  That is the point: two validators have now been written
against an imagined format and rejected valid files --

  - vps_validate looked for a "Vps.public" keyword that does not exist in the
    OpenMX format, and rejected every .vps ADPACK produces;
  - the same function flagged the banner of asterisks a .vps opens with as a
    Fortran overflow marker.

Both would have been caught in seconds by running against one real file.

Provenance of each file
-----------------------

  upf/Si.pbe-oncv.UPF        ONCVPSP 4.0.1, pbe, scalar-relativistic
  van/Si.van                 USPP (Vanderbilt) runatom.x
  vps/{F,Be}.pz-adpack.vps   ADPACK 2.2
  pawxml/Li.r2scan-atompaw.xml   AtomPAW, r2SCAN -- the meta-GGA refusal case
  cpi/Si.pz-fhi98pp.cpi      fhi98PP, pz, via this tool:
                               pseudoforge generate -e Si -t nc -x pz \
                                   --engine fhi98pp --format cpi
                             Kept because it is the file QE 7.6's upfconv.x
                             refuses (see the measurement in lib/convert.sh),
                             and a refusal that cannot be reproduced is a
                             rumour.
  rrkj3/Si.pbe-rrkjus-ld1.rrkj3
                             QE 7.6 ld1.x, PSlibrary 1.0.0 Si US PBE deck,
                             unchanged except file_pseudopw='Si.rrkj3' --
                             ld1 writes the old RRKJ layout for any name not
                             ending in upf (INPUT_LD1, file_pseudopw).
                             pw.x gives the same bulk-Si energy from this
                             file and from its UPF conversion. It is NOT the
                             same pseudopotential as the UPF ld1 writes from
                             that deck: 2.2 eV per cell apart, because the
                             RRKJ layout cannot hold l-resolved augmentation.
  cpmd/Si.pbe-opium.cpmd     OPIUM, pseudoforge-auto Si PBE, --format upf,cpmd.
                             Kept to show cpmd -> upf is refused at runtime:
                             QE 7.x has no CPMD reader in upfconv.x.
